decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Access through the warehouse shall be maintained so as to ensure that the proposed,  and hereby approved, means of servicing the building is maintained.

Condition : 6 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. 083-201-P2 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the extension hereby approved and such facilities shall not be used for any other purposes unless the Local Planning Authority first agrees otherwise in writing.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
